mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 6 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 8, low 6.

Citizens marched through Pristina's main square to the government building, demanding justice for Arlinda Zekajn, marking the seventh consecutive night of protests.

The NATO Parliamentary Assembly said that improved security in Kosovo must be matched by political reforms, stronger democratic institutions and greater public trust.

Montenegro's European Affairs Minister Maida Gorčeviq announced the country will reject a second-stage EU accession with limited rights and still aims to join the bloc by 2028.

Kosovo Prime Minister Albin Kurti reported that DNA analysis has identified three people who disappeared during the 1998-99 war.

Health Minister Rifat Klekovski said a new medicines law is being drafted to fully align Kosovo's pharmaceutical regulations with EU standards after 19 years and more than 20 amendments to the old law.
